an3.32:1.1: Ānanda (and others) ask a series of similar questions later in the Aṅguttara ([an10.6:1.2](), [an11.7:2.1](), [an11.8:2.1](), [an11.18:2.1]()). The question is whether it is possible to realize a state of meditation immersion that is based, not just on the temporary suspension of the five hindrances like the regular four absorptions, but on the permanent eradication of all defilements by the arahant. The commenteries identify this state as the “attainment of the fruition of arahantship”.
